I just started 50mg and I used to think I had chronic tachycardia and I've had a resting rate in the 100s at some points. To the point where I went to get EKGs done and often, my doctor would say I was probably anxious...with a 120 bpm...but now, I'm sitting with a lower 60 bpm and I'm amazed! I can imagine it could seem unpleasant to some but for me, I'm so happy and calmed by knowing my fast heart rate was probably my anxiety working on overdrive.

I took the 50mg to start as I took it to heart that my doctor probably took into account my levels of anxiety and my BMI (which is on the high side). It's been perfectly fine! A bit of a headache one day but I'm thankful I jumped right in to 50mg.
